text:
Maya: Quick heads-up — need to trim Optimize toolkit scope for this sprint. Proposal: ship eval-triggered alerts + lightweight quantization recommendations; postpone persistent KV cache tuning and full adaptive batching.

Aj: Alerts + quant recs look deliverable in ~2 eng-weeks. Adaptive batching is infra-heavy.

Dena: Suggested alert acceptance criteria: webhook median_delivery <5s, false_positive_rate <10% on eval suite, docs + runbook. Quant recs: top 3 model+quant options with cost & quality deltas.

Zach: Ops request: include telemetry tags (customer_id, model_version, route) in payload.

Aj: API sketch: POST /api/v1/evals/{eval_id}/alerts {"threshold":0.8,"destinations":["ops","slack:#alerts"],"mode":"sampled"}. Will reuse webhook dispatcher and add retry plumbing.

Sam: I’ll draft pilot one-pager (what triggers alerts, remediation steps, expected noise) by Thu.

Maya: Canary plan: internal -> 2 pilots -> GA. Gate = pilot signoff + 14 days stability telemetry.

Decision: prioritize eval-triggered alerts + lightweight quant recs; make heuristic batching a stretch goal; defer KV tuning. Maya to update roadmap and product board.
